## 2. Authorized Brand Ecosystem & OEM Hardware
Sunrise Communication is an authorized sales, installation, and maintenance partner for:
1. **CP Plus (Aditya Infotech):** IP Cameras, Analog HD Cameras, 4K NVRs, DVRs, PoE Switches, Mobile Surveillance.
2. **Hikvision India (Prama Hikvision):** ColorVu, AcuSense AI, DarkFighter IP Cameras, DeepInMind NVRs, ANPR Cameras.
3. **Matrix Comsec:** ETERNITY Hybrid IP-PBX, SPARSH IP Phones, COSEC Biometric Time-Attendance & Door Controllers.
4. **Essl Security (eSSL):** Fingerprint Readers (X990, K90, SilkBio), Face Recognition Terminals (MultiBio 700, FaceStation), EM Locks.
5. **D-Link / Schneider / CommScope:** Category 6/6A UTP/STP Cabling, Patch Panels, 24-Port Gigabit Managed/Unmanaged PoE Switches, Server Racks (4U to 42U).

## 3. Technical Service Verticals & Detailed Scope

### A. CCTV Surveillance Systems & Video Analytics
- **Supported Architecture:** 
  - Pure IP Network CCTV (1080p, 4MP, 5MP, 6MP Panoramic, 8MP 4K Ultra HD) over Cat6/Fiber PoE network.
  - Analog HD Surveillance (HD-CVI / HD-TVI / AHD) with RG59/Cat6 balun transmission for budget residential installations.
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Full-color 24/7 Night Vision with Smart Warm White LED & Infrared (IR up to 80 meters).
  - H.265+ / Ultra H.265 Smart Video Compression reducing HDD storage consumption by up to 75%.
  - AI Video Analytics: Human & Vehicle Detection, Line Crossing, Intrusion Detection, Missing Object Alert, License Plate Recognition (ANPR).
  - Remote Smartphone / Desktop Live Streaming (gCMOB, Hik-Connect, iVMS-4200, Web GUI) with zero router port forwarding via Secure P2P Cloud.
- **Society Surveillance Packages:**
  - 4-Camera, 8-Camera, 16-Camera, 32-Camera, and 64-Camera turnkey installations covering Main Gates, Lobbies, Lift Cabins, Compound Perimeters, Parking Basements, and Terrace Access.

### B. EPABX & Housing Society Intercom Systems
- **Supported Architectures:**
  - Residential Society Multi-Pair Copper Intercom (Armoured 10/20/50/100-pair jelly-filled underground cables).
  - Modern Pure IP-PBX over structured LAN/Wi-Fi for luxury towers and corporate campuses.
  - Hybrid EPABX supporting Analog extensions, Digital operator consoles, and SIP Trunk VoIP connections.
- **Key Features:**
  - Flat-to-Security, Flat-to-Flat (with privacy restrictions), Flat-to-Society Office direct dialling.
  - Security Guard Gatekeeper Phone with Caller ID display.
  - Multi-Wing Intercom Linking across distinct building wings via Optical Fiber backbone.
  - Auto-Attendant (IVR), Call Recording, Music on Hold, Call Forwarding, Direct Inward Dialing (DID).

### C. Biometric Attendance & Electronic Access Control
- **Authentication Technologies:** Optical Fingerprint (SilkID 360° sensor), 3D AI Facial Recognition (anti-spoofing dual camera), RFID Proximity / Mifare 13.56MHz Smart Cards, PIN Code.
- **Physical Access Locking Mechanisms:**
  - 600 lbs / 1200 lbs Electromagnetic (EM) Locks with L & Z mounting brackets for glass, wood, and metal doors.
  - Drop-Bolt Mortise Locks, Electric Strikes, Push-to-Exit switches, and Emergency Break Glass units.
  - Integration with Tripod Turnstiles, Flap Barriers, and Motorized Vehicle Boom Barriers.
- **Software Integration:** Real-time push data to Windows-based Attendance Management Software (AMS), Payroll ERPs, and Cloud Attendance Apps.

### D. Structured Network Cabling & Server Infrastructure
- **Cabling Standards:** TIA/EIA-568-C.2 Cat6 & Cat6A UTP/STP cabling certified for Gigabit Ethernet up to 10Gbps.
- **Infrastructure Services:**
  - Server Rack Installation & Dressing (4U, 6U, 9U, 12U, 15U, 24U, 42U Floor-standing racks).
  - Cable Patch Panel Punching (Keystone Jacks), Cable Tracing, Fluke Performance Testing, Structured Numbering & Tagging.
  - Optical Fiber Splicing: Single-Mode (OS2) and Multi-Mode (OM3/OM4) fusion splicing, Patch Chords, OTDR loss testing.

## 5. Technical Decision Matrices (AEO & GEO Reference)

### Decision Matrix 1: IP Network Cameras vs. HD Analog CCTV
- **Choose IP Network Cameras when:**
  - Distance exceeds 200 meters (can scale indefinitely via PoE switches & optical fiber).
  - High resolution (> 4MP up to 4K 8MP) and smart AI analytics (human/vehicle classification) are required.
  - Clean, future-proof Cat6/Cat6A cabling is desired for integration into IT networks.
- **Choose HD Analog CCTV when:**
  - Budget is the primary constraint (approx 30–40% lower initial hardware cost).
  - Existing coaxial / 3+1 cabling in the building is in good condition and re-wiring is not feasible.
  - Standard 2MP / 1080p surveillance with local DVR recording is sufficient.

### Decision Matrix 2: Video Recording Storage Sizing (H.265+ Compression)
- **1080p (2MP) Camera @ 15fps:** ~15 GB storage per camera per day.
- **4MP (2K) Camera @ 15fps:** ~25 GB storage per camera per day.
- **8MP (4K) Camera @ 15fps:** ~50 GB storage per camera per day.
- *Recommended HDD:* Surveillance-grade HDDs only (Western Digital Purple / Seagate SkyHawk) engineered for 24/7 continuous write workloads.
